document.title: HTML report block library
document.summary: A visual catalog of every reusable report block. Open this file to judge the layout; copy the matching JSON block into a report source.
document.provenance: Generic block vocabulary adapted from the E2E evidence report system

blocks.title: Prose
blocks.html:
Use prose for the connective tissue of the report: the conclusion, context a reader needs, or an explanation that does not benefit from a more structured block.

Keep it editorial. A report should explain what matters, not narrate every step used to create it.

blocks.title: Callout
blocks.html: Put the consequential caveat here. Callouts work for decisions, warnings, constraints, and the one detail a scanning reader must not miss.

blocks.title: Quote
blocks.text: A strong report compresses the work without hiding the uncertainty.

blocks.title: Custom HTML
blocks.html:
Standard first

Use the existing block vocabulary for most report content.

Custom when necessary

Compose one unusual layout with semantic HTML and existing shell classes.

Still disposable

Do not turn a quick report into a frontend project.
